title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 24 | The Great Library | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
Books are flying all over the Great Library! The friends catch them and meet Rin the Scholar, a tiny mouse in glasses. Rin finds the Bookworm Golem's weak spot, and at night unrolls an old map to the Grand Raid.

0:00 Flying Books
0:45 Rin the Scholar
1:30 The Bookworm Golem
2:15 A Quiet Reading Night

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
